issue_context.title: Env var to set location of .kube directory
issue_context.body:
It doesn't seem possible to entirely move the `$HOME/.kube` directory, or, therefore, to use multiple under one user (should you want to for some reason - yes I'm aware of contexts).

Setting `$KUBECONFIG` takes care of the config yaml and relative files, but not `cache` and `http-cache` dirs, which are recreated in `$HOME` even if the directory is removed following setting the env var.

It would be good to either respect `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` (and ideally `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` separately, but I won't die on that hill) or at least a `$KUBE_HOME`, which seems to exist for kubeadm/kubelet but not kubectl.

```
$ uname -or ; kubectl version
18.6.0 Darwin
Client Version: version.Info{Major:"1", Minor:"15", GitVersion:"v1.15.0", GitCommit:"e8462b5b5dc2584fdcd18e6bcfe9f1e4d970a529", GitTreeState:"clean", BuildDate:"2019-06-20T04:49:16Z", GoVersion:"go1.12.6", Compiler:"gc", Platform:"darwin/amd64"}
```

/sig cli
/sig usability
comments:
There is some precedence for multiple home environment variables on windows, however none of them are kubernetes specfiic https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/master/util/homedir/homedir.go

cc @liggitt who is everywhere and last touched this code :-)
